objectives.description: Verify zotero-chunk.sh:38-40 resolves under flat model
Re-sync flat copies of edited scripts

approaches_tried.approach: Empirically probed zotero-chunk.sh PROJECT_ROOT resolution using a throwaway repo at both the nested source path and the flat deployed path
approaches_tried.reason: confirmed the fixed 4-level ../../../.. walk-up resolves 2 directories above repo root when flat-deployed -- a genuine bug, not just 'fragile/confusing' as research characterized it

deviations.description: zotero-chunk.sh:38-40 was marked verify-only/optional-comment in the plan, with research asserting it 'should resolve correctly' under the flat-deploy model.
deviations.reason: Empirical probe (throwaway repo, both nested and flat script locations) proved the fixed-depth ../../../.. PROJECT_ROOT computation is genuinely broken when flat-deployed (resolves 2 directories above actual repo root, corrupting ZOTERO_INDEX/LITERATURE_SCRIPTS_DIR/CHUNK_DIR). Fixed per orchestrator instruction 'change only if actually broken' by replacing the fixed depth with a dynamic walk-up to the nearest ancestor containing .claude/.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — plan said verify-only, but escalated to a fix after empirical verification proved it broken)*
